meta.name: vois-router
meta.description: Orchestrates the Vois design system skill chain. Use this skill as the single entry point whenever you're doing any UI work against the Vois design system — building a screen, picking a component, writing copy, or defending a design decision. The router reads your input, identifies the right starting point and skill sequence, and packages context forward so you don't have to re-explain the problem at each step. Works with vois-patterns, vois-components, vois-tokens, righter, and design-rationale. Each of those skills can still be used standalone — this router is additive, not a replacement. Trigger when someone says "build this screen", "what component should I use", "help me write this copy", "route me through the design system", or pastes any feature brief, ticket, or design question without specifying which skill to use.
